C1_dependencies.name: ConNF.TSet.exists_cardinalOne
C1_dependencies.content:
theorem exists_cardinalOne :
    ∃ x : TSet α, ∀ a : TSet β, a ∈[hβ] x ↔ ∃ b, a = singleton hγ b := by
  have := exists_of_symmetric {a | ∃ b, a = singleton hγ b} hβ ?_
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
    use y
    intro a
    rw [hy]
    rfl
  · use ⟨.empty, .empty⟩
    intro ρ hρ
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨ρ ↘ hβ ↘ hγ • a, ?_⟩
      simp only [ha, smul_singleton]
    · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
      rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
      refine ⟨ρ⁻¹ ↘ hβ ↘ hγ • a, ?_⟩
      simp only [ha, smul_singleton, allPerm_inv_sderiv']
